observations: Photo 0 shows a PS4 console stack with two DualShock 4 controller boxes visible in the background.
The console face/label is not clearly readable in the photo to confirm it is a PS4 Pro (e.g., CUH model/1TB marking).
No clear photo of the console ports, power-on screen, or installed game list.
No clear photo of the included items count (10 games) or whether the pads are included/working.

claims.claim: Very clean UK-Used PS4 Pro Console with 10 games and two pads
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable PS4 Pro identifier (model/label) and does not show the game list or the exact included quantity.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal/serial/model verification or proof of non-repair is visible in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows no temperature/thermal test or gameplay stress test.
Photo 0 does not show ports being tested (HDMI/USB/Ethernet/audio) or any connected peripherals working.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows controller packaging boxes, but does not clearly show the actual controllers included, and no UK receipt is visible.

risks.risk: Console may not be PS4 Pro (could be PS4 Slim/Fat), which changes value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the console model label (CUH-xxxx) and/or the back label showing Pro vs Slim, plus a photo of the console boot screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PS4 console bundle at the lowest comparable level for PS4 bundles.

risks.risk: 10 games may be incorrect (could be fewer, or games may be demo/locked, or not installed).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video of the Games library screen showing the installed games count (10) and titles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to include 10 installed games.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or not fully functional (stick drift, broken buttons).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing both controllers connected and working in-game (button presses + analog movement) and a close-up of controller model/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers not proven fully working.

risks.risk: Ports may not work (HDMI/USB/Ethernet), which affects usability.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing HDMI output to TV and at least one USB device/controller charging/connection working; also show Ethernet port if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports not fully proven.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues may exist despite claims.
risks.proof: Ask for a gameplay/stress clip (e.g., 20–30 minutes) with no shutdown and normal fan behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst-case usability).

risks.risk: UK receipt may not exist or may not match the console.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the UK receipt with matching serial/model (or at least the receipt details).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console back/model label (CUH-xxxx) to confirm PS4 Pro vs Slim/Fat.
Photo/video of the console boot screen and the Games library showing exactly 10 installed games.
Video showing both controllers connected and fully responsive (buttons + analog sticks) and charging/connection working.
Video showing HDMI output working and at least 2 ports tested (USB + audio/Ethernet if applicable).
Photo of the UK receipt (and ideally matching serial/model).
response.reason: From photo 0, the PS4 Pro identity and the key bundle claims (10 games, working ports, working controllers, receipt) are not verifiable, so a safe price cannot be selected without the decisive proof shots.
